item.tib: thugs dam dgyes sprod kyi bskongs ba
item.coloph: rig 'dzin 'dus pa thabs chen mkha' yi rgyud las/ thugs dam dgyes spyod bskong (skong) gi 'phyang zhes bya ba/ bla chen po dran pa nam mkha' yis/ khyung lung dngul mkhar du gtan la phab nas/ sems dpa' rje blon stong gsum/ ra sang khod ram dang bzhi la gdams pa'o/ gsang ba mdos kyi gyer gzhung rdzogs so//
